cauchy_stress_observable.rationale: The visualization UMAT operates as a non-load-bearing diagnostic layer (tangent DDSDDE = 1e-11, S = 0). Mechanical equilibrium is solved exclusively by UEL Layers 1 and 2. Continuum element output requests on user elements produce benign informational warnings. Physical fracture validation observables are completely governed by RF2, U2, phase-field damage d (SDV1), history H (SDV2), and crack geometry.

step_1.name: Step-1
step_1.assessment: Quasi-static loading toward peak displacement. Diffuse damage nucleation and initial stiffness are treated as measured, output-dependent quantities rather than assumed zero.

step_2.name: Step-2
step_2.assessment: Conservative initial increment (0.014 um per inc) allows fine resolution of peak force and gradual softening initiation. Automatic cutbacks down to 1.0e-8 provide numerical tolerance while actual solver behavior will be governed by authentic residual convergence and increment history.

hpc_audit.parallel_safety_rationale: Per independent review Finding F1735-R01 and AGENTS.md, Fortran COMMON blocks in f42_mixed_uel.for lack OpenMP thread locks, so multi-threaded SMP is disqualified to prevent race conditions. 1-CPU serial execution guarantees strict deterministic element ordering, zero thread races, and bitwise reproducibility. Multi-rank MPI remains strictly disqualified.

scientific_checks.name: Numerical Convergence
scientific_checks.criterion: Both Step-1 and Step-2 complete without solver divergence, non-finite arithmetic, or cutback stall (min dt >= 1.0e-8).

scientific_checks.name: Phase-Field Physical Bounds
scientific_checks.criterion: 0.0 <= d <= 1.0 strictly maintained across all 23,965 physical elements at all converged increments.

scientific_checks.name: Damage Irreversibility
scientific_checks.criterion: dot(d) >= 0 and H_{n+1} >= H_n strictly maintained; Delta d >= -1.0e-6 across all converged increments.

scientific_checks.name: Output Field Integrity & Diagnostics
scientific_checks.criterion: Centroid d, history H, and energy quantities populated on umatelem; reaction force RF_y recorded at node 999999; Cauchy stress S treated as zero.

scientific_checks.name: Load-Displacement Response
scientific_checks.criterion: Measure initial stiffness K_0, peak force F_max, and post-peak softening profile; evaluate deviations from coarse baseline (0.731 kN) as physical discretization effects.

scientific_checks.name: Crack Path & Deflection Observable
scientific_checks.criterion: Reconstruct crack trajectory from connected damage (d >= 0.95); evaluate initiation at notch tip (0.50, 0.50) mm and deflection toward hole as an observed physical response against literature.

scientific_checks.name: Thermodynamic Energy Evolution
scientific_checks.criterion: Extract integrated fracture energy E_frac and strain energy E_elas vs displacement from STATEV(17), STATEV(18) and uel_energy_balance.csv.
